subtitle: UPDATE Aug 2, 16:45 BRT, 63 days to the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). THE GAP WIDENED FROM THE OTHER SIDE. Lula held FLAT at 65.50% (vol USD 7.90M) and the gap over Flávio WIDENED to +40.95pp, against +40.75pp in the capture published yesterday, but it widened because FLÁVIO FELL 0.20pp, not because the favourite rose. In the two previous sessions the record came with the rival rising alongside; today it is the opposite, and the mechanism matters more than the direction. THE SERIES HIGH IS NOW BEHIND US and the window has to be stated in full: Lula's maximum is 66.50% and the gap maximum is +41.80pp, both from the Aug 1 CLOSE, and both above what this panel publishes today. The AFOS series runs from Apr 14 to today, 108 days, and was checked straight against the database, without the API's 90-day cap. RENAN SANTOS is the move of the day: UP 0.35pp to 7.95% (vol USD 8.82M), BREAKING a losing streak that had lasted nine rounds. There was NO event of his on the date: Missão confirmed the candidacy on Jul 20, at a convention brought forward, and held the campaign launch event on Aug 1. Today's rise is market movement with no fresh fact to track. The turn does not undo the arc: he came from 12.00% on Jul 23 and touched 7.10% at the Aug 1 close, and it is not a series low, because the low is 5.30%, from Apr 26. THE CHASING PACK SPLIT, unlike yesterday, when it shrank as a whole: Camilo Santana rose 0.20pp to 0.65%, Jair Bolsonaro rose 0.10pp to 0.65% and Haddad rose 0.05pp to 0.30%, while Caiado fell 0.20pp to 1.15%, Zema fell 0.10pp to 0.25%, and Michelle and Tereza Cristina each fell 0.10pp, both to 0.15%. CAIADO TOUCHED THE SERIES FLOOR WITHIN THE DAY ITSELF: the 11:30 UTC collection recorded 0.90%, matching the lowest value since Apr 14, already registered between Jul 5 and Jul 9, and the locked capture at 19:42 UTC shows 1.15%. The panel publishes the locked capture and records the intraday floor rather than picking between the two. IN THE PLACEMENT BOOKS, Flávio rose 1.00pp in second place in the first round, to 80.50%, his highest mark there over the panel's coverage, and Renan rose 2.00pp in third place, to 63.50%, with Caiado rising the same 2.00pp, to 24.50%. THE POLITICAL DAY BELONGED TO THE PT NATIONAL CONVENTION: the party formally launched Lula with Alckmin in São Paulo, bringing together SEVEN parties (PT, PCdoB, PV, PSB, PDT, PSOL and Rede), the largest left and centre-left coalition since 1989, in his eighth run for the presidency. Flávio Bolsonaro attended the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) STATE convention in Paraíba, in João Pessoa, which launched Efraim Filho for governor and Marcelo Queiroga for the Senate, in a stated strategy of widening his presence in the Northeast, the rival's historic stronghold. ON AUG 1, not today, Lula and Flávio ASKED FOR VOTES AHEAD OF THE LEGAL WINDOW, which only opens on Aug 16, he at the [PT](/en/glossary#pt) convention in Bahia and Flávio at the PL convention in Santa Catarina, and the record covers both, not one. Flávio and Zema still have NO running mates three days from the Aug 5 deadline, and Valor Econômico records that the two front-runners reached the final stretch of the convention season without broadening alliances, with the [Centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) still neutral. NATIONAL POLLING DID NOT MOVE and now has a date to move: the most recent remains Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100, fieldwork Jul 26 to 28, 2.15pp margin, 95% confidence, BR-01084/2026), today's [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) sweep read 538 filings and inserted NONE, and FOUR national polls are in the field right now, two from Nexus, one from [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and one from Ideia/Canal Meio, with publication declared between Aug 3 and Aug 5. A declared date on a filing is not publication. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 118.11M. The double-reading lock PASSED the round with no blocking reason, both books within 0.20pp. All prices enter firm, with no declared range. Live capture Aug 2 at 19:42 UTC.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: Polymarket 65.50% (flat, vol USD 7.90M accumulated), 63 days from the election, on the day the [PT](/en/glossary#pt) formally launched his candidacy at a national convention. The gap over Flávio widens to +40.95pp, but it widens through the rival's fall. The price is 1.00pp BELOW the series high, which is 66.50%, from the Aug 1 close. No fresh national polling: the most recent remains Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100), with 40.5% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47.5% against 41.1% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno).
fortes: The [PT](/en/glossary#pt) formally launched his candidacy at a national convention in São Paulo, with Alckmin as running mate and seven parties in the alliance, in his eighth run for the presidency.
Vox Brasil gives 47.5% x 41.1% in the runoff, and the 6.4pp fall OUTSIDE the two margins added together, so this reading does NOT describe a statistical tie.
Two of the week's three houses measure the first-round gap around 9pp, 9.1pp at AtlasIntel and 9.3pp at Vox, and the one that departs is PoderData, with 6pp.
He held FLAT in a session where the rival gave ground, which widened the gap without him having to rise.
In his camp the market rose: Camilo Santana gained 0.20pp to 0.65%, and Haddad gained 0.05pp to 0.30%.
fracos: The price is 1.00pp BELOW the series high, which is 66.50%, from the Aug 1 close, and the gap is 0.85pp below the maximum, which is +41.80pp from the same day.
The gap widened through Flávio's fall, not through his own rise, which describes a weaker mechanism than the one in the two previous sessions.
The 40.5% at Vox in the first round remain below 50% plus one vote, meaning the reading describes a runoff and not a first-round win.
No national poll has published approval or rejection since Jul 30, so the assessment picture still has two houses pointing in opposite directions in the same week.

He asked for votes ahead of the legal window on Aug 1, at the [PT](/en/glossary#pt) convention in Bahia, and Flávio did the same on the same day, in Santa Catarina. The campaign only opens on Aug 16, and the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) had already fined Lula R$ 15,000 for early electoral propaganda on Jul 28.
candidates.analise: His day was one of convention and a standing price, and the cross-reading of the two is the record. The winner contract held FLAT at 65.50% (vol USD 7.90M) on the same Sunday the [PT](/en/glossary#pt) formally launched his candidacy in São Paulo, with Alckmin as running mate and seven parties in the alliance. The gap WIDENED to +40.95pp, but it widened because Flávio fell 0.20pp, not because he rose, which inverts the mechanism of the two previous sessions. THE HIGH IS NOW BEHIND US and the window has to be stated: the series maximum is 66.50%, from the Aug 1 close, and today's price is 1.00pp below it. The AFOS series runs from Apr 14 to today, 108 days. NO FRESH POLLING, and now with a date for the next: no national poll has been published since Vox Brasil of Jul 31, today's [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) sweep inserted no new filing, and four national polls are in the field, with publication declared between Aug 3 and Aug 5. AT THE CONVENTION, the ticket with Alckmin was formally approved and the coalition brought together SEVEN parties (PT, PCdoB, PV, PSB, PDT, PSOL and Rede), the largest on the left and centre-left since 1989. According to Folha de S.Paulo, he said he does not want to be the Bolsa Família president and promised to fight Congress over earmarks. The request for votes ahead of the legal window was on AUG 1, at the Bahia convention, and Flávio did the same on the same day, in Santa Catarina. ON THE JUDICIAL AXIS, the two inquiries into Lulinha sharpened the tension between Mendonça and the Federal Police, his lawyer accuses parts of the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) of trying to interfere in the election, and Roberta Luchsinger asked for an investigation into leaked conversations. An inquiry is not a conviction and the panel does not treat it as one.

It is the first time in three sessions that the gap moves from his side rather than the favourite's.
